title: Squirrel Brawl
description: Relive beloved classic platformer charm—leap across treetop stages, lift and toss acorns and crates at cheeky foes, and collect sparkling nuts.
controls: Move, jump, pick up crates, and toss them at enemies across lively retro stages.

zh-CN.title: 松鼠大战
zh-CN.description: 怀旧红白机情怀松鼠大战：操控敏捷小松鼠跑跳搬箱子砸小怪，重温经典横版动作闯关的纯粹快乐！
zh-CN.controls: 控制小松鼠左右移动、跳跃并举起木箱投掷击败小怪，一路闯关通关。
